finding: The inherited dry-run five-arm matrix did not contain the issue-required SMALL_CLOSED_BOOK or LARGE_CLOSED_BOOK controls. A separate exact five-arm issue-outcome pilot matrix and real local runner were added. This does not relabel the inherited 960-run dry-run matrix or close the issue.

facts: Three small-profile invocations completed and produced immutable local receipt digests.
The combined process was killed while entering the large-profile phase because the context size was not bounded.
Prompt echo contaminated the first scorer implementation, so no quality result is admitted.

realPilotAttempts.invalidationReason: The model reasoning stream could contain both instruction tokens and candidate answers; substring scoring was not a valid final-answer scorer. Raw transcript bytes were intentionally not published, only their digests, so the attempt cannot be rescored. The runner now requires a closed reasoning block and an exact final answer.

newTests: closed-book prompts receive no Knowledge bytes
tddEvidence.sabotage: Temporarily leaking raw Knowledge into closed-book prompts made the closed-book isolation test fail; the fix was restored and the test passed.

acceptanceStatus.criterion: Identical hidden/fresh tasks and Knowledge versions across arms
acceptanceStatus.evidence: The real pilot binds one fresh synthetic task identically across five arms; the full hidden multi-domain schedule is not executed.

acceptanceStatus.criterion: Structured-vs-raw, facts-vs-guidance, static-vs-updated, single-vs-multi-hop A/B results
acceptanceStatus.evidence: The bounded issue-outcome pilot covers closed-book, naive RAG and Fabric only; inherited dry-run A/B fixtures are not measurements.
Attempt and terminal counts plus receipt digests are preserved; n=1/arm has no valid CI and scorer-invalidated outputs have no admitted quality scores.

acceptanceStatus.criterion: Stop conditions can falsify or simplify architecture
acceptanceStatus.evidence: Resource and instrumentation stops invalidated pilots without product verdict; STOP-07 and FALSIFY-SUBSTITUTION remain active.

acceptanceStatus.criterion: No substitution claim unless quality and efficiency pass
acceptanceStatus.evidence: No quality or efficiency threshold passed; model substitution remains denied.

exactExecutableBlocker: Issue #285 remains open. Before closure, execute a new fresh protocol edition with the corrected exact-final scorer over enough independent tasks, both Knowledge editions, required structured/raw, facts/guidance, update and hop contrasts, resource/token/memory/throughput/cost collection, and confidence intervals. Preserve each terminal record before the next run. The existing 960-run dry-run fixtures and all three pilot attempts are excluded from a closure claim.
